paper.title: On the Asymptotic Efficiency of Certain Nonparametric Two-Sample Tests
paper.author: A. M. Mood
paper.access_boundary: The indexed publisher record and abstract were read. Direct scripted PDF retrieval returned an Incapsula block page rather than the article; no complete-paper body read, derivation reconstruction, or paper-file hash is claimed.

bounded_read.source_scope_read: scipy.stats.mood plus _mood_statistic_no_ties and the immediately associated documentation
verified_claims: Mood is a nonparametric two-sample test for equal scale parameters
the pooled observations receive average ranks
the first sample score is the sum of squared distances of its ranks from (N+1)/2
for x lower-scale than y, the returned standardized statistic is negative
the source computes a normal-reference p-value after the statistic

claim_boundary: The records support the named squared-rank two-sample scale method and exact no-tie arithmetic only. They do not test WTI, fixed six-by-six monthly blocks, the inclusive non-contraction rule, cumulative-return continuation, CFDs, fixed risk, activity, or performance. The EA imports no SciPy, Python, normal CDF, p-value, or executable source.
